articles.summary: Ensure compliance and maximize asset value with effective inventory traceability and tracking for Public Works and Utility departments. Learn how to optimize your surplus sales process.

articles.summary: Uncover creative ways to repurpose and sell surplus golf equipment, turning idle assets into revenue while supporting sustainability and operational efficiency goals. Learn innovative strategies for repurposing and selling surplus golf equipment, showcasing successful examples from various organizations that generate revenue and promote sustainability through online marketplaces like GovDeals.
articles.title: Beyond the Course: Creative Ways to Repurpose and Sell Golf Equipment
